name: Armenia
summary: Landlocked South Caucasus nation with high-elevation plateau geography. Ararat valley basin experiences seasonal particulate stagnation alongside nuclear, hydro, and gas power generation.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 5.88x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Yerevan mountain basin traps vehicular exhaust and construction dust.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; Lake Sevan water levels and mountain hydrology sensitive to thermal anomalies.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: High-altitude Caucasus warming trend rate of +0.41 °C per decade over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.02% share of global emissions; natural gas thermal plants and residential space heating drive total.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Moderate per capita footprint; Metsamor nuclear plant and hydro reduce power carbon intensity.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Oak and beech mountain woodlands in Tavush and Lori covering ~3,300 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Sevan-Hrazdan and Vorotan river cascade hydroelectric stations supply ~30% of national power.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 98 people/km²; urban population fraction is 63.4%.
